Registry index for the private cloud-me family (Cloud-Me-Pvt) - same model as `CG-___`, `Fin-CM-___` and `cloudy-___`. This repo is an INDEX, not a container: it holds `repos.json` (the registry, a subset of _git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json), `clone.sh` (pick which repos to have locally) and one committed relative symlink per member (`<member> -> ../<member>`); the actual clones live as siblings in `~/git/`.

Parent hub: [cloud-me-___](https://github.com/diegonmarcos/cloud-me-___), the top hub of the cloud-me project (the owner's configs across the cloud).

## Usage

```
./clone.sh                list what exists and what does not
./clone.sh <name>...      clone those, then link them
./clone.sh --all          clone every member
./clone.sh --link         relink whatever is already cloned
./clone.sh --relink       rewrite every link from the registry
./check-repos-sot.sh      verify repos.json against _git-repos-master
```

`repos.json` is a SUBSET of `~/git/_git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json` (the superset index of every repo this account owns): identical name/url/private/doc fields, checked by `./check-repos-sot.sh`.

## Clone depth

`clone.sh` clones with `--depth 1 --shallow-submodules` by default: only the latest commit, so a clone is fast and takes little disk. Each repo has exactly ONE clone (in `$CLOUD_GIT_BASE`); the links point at it, so never keep a second full copy next to it.

```
./clone.sh <name>...                 # shallow, depth 1 (default)
./clone.sh --full <name>...          # full history (same as CLONE_DEPTH=0)
CLONE_DEPTH=50 ./clone.sh <name>...  # a deeper shallow clone
git -C <clone> fetch --unshallow     # later, turn an existing clone into full history
git -C <clone> submodule update --init --depth 1   # submodules stay shallow too
```

Only the upward link is a submodule; this hub keeps symlinks (not submodules) to its members, so there are no cycles.
